observations.procedure: Inspect the exact material diff and the existing dashboard, card settlement, transaction temporal contract, and web dashboard consumer.
observations.observed: The material changes only the financial-summary repository, adds one integration test and documentation. The web dashboard continues consuming API totals directly. Card purchases have no account cash effect while invoice payments persist an account-linked effective transaction and Invoice.paymentTransactionId remains the settlement discriminator.

observations.procedure: Inspect the exact material dashboard cash query against deliberately distinct economic, planned and effective dates represented by the new integration fixture.
observations.observed: availableBalanceMinor is opening balance of active accounts plus only POSTED/RECONCILED movements with effectiveOn on or before the reference date. Income and expense require an active source account; transfers debit active source and credit active destination, so an internal active-account transfer is net zero. A card purchase without accountId/effectiveOn cannot reduce bank cash before settlement.

observations.procedure: Inspect the realized economic aggregation and the settlement exclusion predicate on the exact material head.
observations.observed: Monthly income/expense uses occurredOn, accepts only POSTED/RECONCILED income/expense, excludes transfers, and excludes only the transaction referenced by an Invoice.paymentTransactionId in the same organization/profile. No description, value, date similarity or cardId heuristic is used.

observations.procedure: Inspect the planned commitment aggregation on the exact material head and compare it with the canonical transaction date contract.
observations.observed: plannedCommitmentsMinor uses plannedOn for PLANNED/SUGGESTED expenses only while effectiveOn is absent. The invoice forecast remains a future commitment before settlement and is voided by the canonical invoice payment flow rather than counted beside the realized payment.

observations.procedure: Inspect the new integration fixture for discriminant cases covering the issue acceptance criteria and plausible wrong implementations.
observations.observed: The fixture covers opening balances, account income, account expense, active-account transfer, different occurredOn/plannedOn/effectiveOn dates, card purchase, invoice forecast, invoice settlement, and an unrelated expense with the same amount and description as the payment. It checks June and July summaries using injected reference dates.
